queries.name: CQ_Billed
CQ_Unbilled
CQ_UnbilledReturn
CQ_追跡
queries.sql:
SELECT m.TransactionNo AS 取引番号, s.sumi AS 売上ID, s.ClientID AS 得意先ID, s.ProductName AS 商品名, s.Quantity AS 売上数量, s.Amount AS 売上金額, i.InvoiceID AS 請求ID, i.BilledQuantity AS 請求数量, i.NetAmount AS 請求税抜, i.TaxAmount AS 請求税額, b.PaymentState AS 入金状態, b.OutstandingAmount AS 請求単位残額
FROM ((S_SaleMeta AS m INNER JOIN T_売上台帳 AS s ON m.SalesID=s.sumi) LEFT JOIN S_InvoiceSource AS i ON s.sumi=i.SalesID) LEFT JOIN SQ_請求残 AS b ON i.InvoiceID=b.InvoiceID;

queries.sql:
SELECT *
FROM J_Error
WHERE Status <> '解消済'
ORDER BY OccurredAt DESC;

queries.name: SQ_月別売上
queries.sql:
SELECT Year(SalesDate) AS 売上年, Month(SalesDate) AS 売上月, Sum(Amount) AS 税抜売上, Sum(Quantity) AS 数量
FROM T_売上台帳
GROUP BY Year(SalesDate), Month(SalesDate)
ORDER BY Year(SalesDate), Month(SalesDate);

queries.name: SQ_顧客別売上
queries.sql:
SELECT ClientID AS 得意先ID, ClientName AS 得意先名, Sum(Amount) AS 税抜売上, Sum(Quantity) AS 数量
FROM T_売上台帳
GROUP BY ClientID, ClientName
ORDER BY ClientID;

queries.name: SQ_取引状況
queries.sql: SELECT q.QuoteID AS 見積ID,q.ClientID AS 得意先ID,q.QuoteDate AS 見積日,q.Status AS 見積状態,o.OrderID AS 受注ID,o.OrderDate AS 受注日,o.Status AS 受注状態 FROM S_Quote AS q LEFT JOIN S_Order AS o ON q.QuoteID=o.QuoteID UNION ALL SELECT Null,o.ClientID,Null,Null,o.OrderID,o.OrderDate,o.Status FROM S_Order AS o WHERE o.QuoteID Is Null;

queries.name: SQ_取引明細
queries.sql: SELECT o.QuoteID AS 見積ID,o.OrderID AS 受注ID,o.ClientID AS 得意先ID,o.Status AS 取引状態,o.OrderLineID AS 受注明細ID,o.ProductName AS 商品名,o.Quantity AS 受注数,o.DeliveredQuantity AS 累計納品数,o.RemainingQuantity AS 受注残数,d.DeliveryID AS 納品ID,d.DeliveryLineID AS 納品明細ID,d.Quantity AS 今回納品数,IIf(r.ReturnedQuantity Is Null,0,r.ReturnedQuantity) AS 返品数,d.SalesID AS 売上ID,i.InvoiceID AS 請求ID,b.PaymentState AS 入金状態,b.OutstandingAmount AS 請求単位残額 FROM (((SQ_受注明細状況 AS o LEFT JOIN S_DeliveryLine AS d ON o.OrderLineID=d.OrderLineID) LEFT JOIN S_InvoiceSource AS i ON d.SalesID=i.SalesID) LEFT JOIN SQ_請求残 AS b ON i.InvoiceID=b.InvoiceID) LEFT JOIN SQ_返品集計 AS r ON d.DeliveryLineID=r.DeliveryLineID UNION ALL SELECT q.QuoteID,Null,q.ClientID,q.Status,Null,l.ProductName,l.Quantity,0,0,Null,Null,0,0,Null,Null,Null,Null FROM (S_Quote AS q INNER JOIN S_QuoteLine AS l ON q.QuoteID=l.QuoteID) LEFT JOIN S_Order AS o ON q.QuoteID=o.QuoteID WHERE o.OrderID Is Null;

queries.name: SQ_受注残
SQ_受注明細状況
queries.sql:
SELECT o.OrderID, o.QuoteID, o.ClientID, o.OrderDate, o.Status, l.OrderLineID, l.ProductID, l.ProductName, l.Quantity, l.UnitPrice, l.Amount, l.CancelledQuantity, IIf(d.TotalDelivered Is Null,0,d.TotalDelivered) AS DeliveredQuantity, l.Quantity-l.CancelledQuantity-IIf(d.TotalDelivered Is Null,0,d.TotalDelivered) AS RemainingQuantity
FROM (S_Order AS o INNER JOIN S_OrderLine AS l ON o.OrderID=l.OrderID) LEFT JOIN SQ_納品集計 AS d ON l.OrderLineID=d.OrderLineID;

queries.name: SQ_商品別売上
queries.sql:
SELECT ProductID AS 商品ID, ProductName AS 商品名, Sum(Amount) AS 税抜売上, Sum(Quantity) AS 数量
FROM T_売上台帳
GROUP BY ProductID, ProductName
ORDER BY ProductID;

queries.name: SQ_請求残
queries.sql:
SELECT i.InvoiceID, i.InvoiceNumber, i.ClientID, i.TotalAmount, IIf(r.TotalCredit Is Null,0,r.TotalCredit) AS ReturnCreditAmount, IIf(a.AllocatedAmount Is Null,0,a.AllocatedAmount) AS PaidAmount, i.TotalAmount-IIf(r.TotalCredit Is Null,0,r.TotalCredit)-IIf(a.AllocatedAmount Is Null,0,a.AllocatedAmount) AS OutstandingAmount, IIf(i.TotalAmount-IIf(r.TotalCredit Is Null,0,r.TotalCredit)-IIf(a.AllocatedAmount Is Null,0,a.AllocatedAmount)<0,"返金・消込解除待ち",IIf(i.TotalAmount-IIf(r.TotalCredit Is Null,0,r.TotalCredit)-IIf(a.AllocatedAmount Is Null,0,a.AllocatedAmount)=0,"入金済",IIf(a.AllocatedAmount>0,"一部入金","請求済"))) AS PaymentState
FROM (S_InvoiceControl AS i LEFT JOIN JQ_消込合計 AS a ON i.InvoiceID=a.InvoiceID) LEFT JOIN SQ_返品請求調整 AS r ON i.InvoiceID=r.InvoiceID;

queries.name: SQ_納品集計
SQ_納品状況
queries.sql:
SELECT d.DeliveryID AS 納品ID, d.OrderID AS 受注ID, l.DeliveryLineID AS 納品明細ID, l.OrderLineID AS 受注明細ID, d.DeliveryDate AS 納品日, s.ClientID AS 得意先ID, s.ProductName AS 商品名, l.Quantity AS 納品数, IIf(r.ReturnedQuantity Is Null,0,r.ReturnedQuantity) AS 返品数, l.Quantity-IIf(r.ReturnedQuantity Is Null,0,r.ReturnedQuantity) AS 返品可能数, s.Amount AS 売上金額, l.SalesID AS 売上ID
FROM ((S_Delivery AS d INNER JOIN S_DeliveryLine AS l ON d.DeliveryID=l.DeliveryID) INNER JOIN T_売上台帳 AS s ON l.SalesID=s.sumi) LEFT JOIN SQ_返品集計 AS r ON l.DeliveryLineID=r.DeliveryLineID;

queries.name: SQ_売上請求状況
queries.sql:
SELECT s.sumi AS 売上ID, s.ClientID AS 得意先ID, s.ProductID AS 商品ID, s.SalesDate AS 売上日, s.Amount AS 税抜売上, i.InvoiceID AS 請求ID, b.PaymentState AS 入金状態, b.OutstandingAmount AS 請求単位残額
FROM (T_売上台帳 AS s LEFT JOIN S_InvoiceSource AS i ON s.sumi=i.SalesID) LEFT JOIN SQ_請求残 AS b ON i.InvoiceID=b.InvoiceID;
